scope: User-approved exact finite CPU learning trial: one-step clean structural risk versus reference edge CE, with the original reverse kernel held fixed
reuse: terminal_structure_audit_20261109 FiniteDiffusion, graph, priors, noise, predictor, initializations and four-block structural cost unchanged
optimizer: plain gradient descent; NOT production AdamW
learning_rate_source: Frozen previous finite experiment; no search, normalization, clipping or adaptive backtracking
input_distribution: t uniform on 1,2,3; Xt exactly enumerated under q(Xt|the single reference); NOT on-policy occupancy
CE: Mean over six edge slots, then expectation over qref and t; exact gradient
structure: Expected hard-graph cost under independent clean Bernoulli prediction, expectation over qref and t; exact gradient, no CE addition
terminal_evaluation: Enumerate the full reverse distribution from the frozen family prior, using unchanged production per-clean-state Bayes posterior mixture; do not train through this endpoint
metrics: each of four structural cost blocks
per-time forward-input and generated-state clean risk
gate: Exact gradient versus central finite difference <=1e-7; kernel/row and qref normalization and t1 identity <=1e-10; any failed numerical check stops affected execution
interpretation: Finite mechanism evidence, not proof of monotonic structure improvement, diversity or real O/A performance. Same learning rate and updates do not equalize two objectives' gradient scales.
not_run: random hard graph or reverse-chain generation
